options.name: api_version
options.description: Sensu API version of the resource to replicate.

options.name: auth
options.description: Authentication parameters. Can define each of them with ENV as well.

options.name: ca_cert
options.description: Path to an the PEM-format CA certificate to use for TLS client authentication. Required if I(insecure) is C(false).

options.name: cert
options.description: Path to the PEM-format certificate to use for TLS client authentication. This certificate is required for secure client communication. Required if I(insecure) is C(false).

options.name: insecure
options.description: Disable transport security. Only set to C(true) in sandbox and experimental environments.

options.name: key
options.description: Path to the PEM-format key file associated with the cert to use for TLS client authentication. This key and its corresponding certificate are required for secure client communication. Required if I(insecure) is C(false).

options.name: name
options.description: The Sensu resource's name. This name (in combination with the namespace where applicable) uniquely identifies the resource that Ansible operates on. If the resource with selected name already exists, Ansible module will update it to match the specification in the task. Consult the I(name) metadata attribute specification in the upstream docs on U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/reference/) for more details about valid names and other restrictions.

options.name: namespace
options.description: Namespace to constrain replication to. If you do not include namespace, all namespaces for a given resource are replicated.

options.name: replication_interval
options.description: Interval at which the resource will be replicated. In seconds.

options.name: resource
options.description: Name of the resource to replicate. List of all resources is available at U(https://docs.sensu.io/sensu-go/latest/operations/control-access/rbac/#resources). Required if I(state) is C(present).

options.name: state
options.description: Target state of the Sensu object.

options.name: url
options.description: Destination cluster URLs. Required if I(state) is C(present).
